# Foldnote

> Official summary for Foldnote, a visual note-taking app for iPhone built for personal planning and shared spaces.

Foldnote helps people create, organize, and share notes using structured blocks, folders, stickers, reminders, and shared spaces.

## Key facts

- Product: Foldnote
- Company: Ruzname Labs
- Website: https://foldnote.app/
- Contact: mailto:info@foldnote.app
- Platform: iPhone
- Category: Visual note-taking app

## Core topics

- Visual note-taking
- Shared notes and groups
- Blocks, folders, stickers, and paper styles
- Personal planning, routines, travel, study, and household coordination

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://foldnote.app/
- Privacy Policy: https://foldnote.app/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://foldnote.app/terms
